rule: The top-bar switch moves between Instant Shock (creator) and the chosen brand.
brand: Brand workspace for that brand, brand seat highlighted.
creator: Creator dashboard, creator seat highlighted.

rule: Switching keeps context.
brand: From a creator chat or deal: the same conversation or deal as that brand.
creator: From a brand chat or deal with Instant Shock: the same conversation or deal.

rule: Each seat shows how many things wait on it.
brand: Count of counter-offers, pitches, proofs to review, renewal requests and unread messages.
creator: Count of offers to answer and unread messages.

rule: The brand seat shows brand figures, not the creator's.
brand: Top bar: the brand's escrow, its to-do bell and avatar. Phone menu: overview, deals, approvals, messages, offers.
creator: Not affected.

rule: Sending an offer to Instant Shock (new offer, package booking, campaign shortlist).
brand: Sent, waiting on creators, with a reply timer.
creator: The offer in Messages (that brand's thread), Today, Open offers and notifications, with what's included.

rule: Pitching a package from a brand's profile.
brand: A pitch under Needs your response.
creator: Pitch sent, waiting on the brand.

rule: Countering a brand's offer adds a version and restarts the 24-hour window.
brand: Needs your response: the new price and what the brand offered before.
creator: Counter sent, waiting on the brand.

rule: Countering a creator's counter or pitch adds a version and restarts the 24-hour window.
brand: Sent, waiting on the creator.
creator: Offer updated, with what changed.

rule: Accepting the other side's latest version creates a deal with one milestone per deliverable.
brand: Accepted, deal awaiting funding.
creator: Deal in Deals, awaiting funding; conversation says deal activated.

rule: Declining the other side's latest version closes the offer.
brand: Declined, with who declined.
creator: Offer declined; the conversation stays open.

rule: Withdrawing an offer that's waiting on the creator.
brand: Withdrawn.
creator: Offer withdrawn.

rule: An offer not answered in its reply window expires.
brand: Expired, no reply in time; a new offer can be sent. Nobody can act on it.
creator: Offer expired; no accept or counter.

rule: Blocked: accepting or countering your own latest version.
brand: No accept on its own sent offer; the engine refuses it.
creator: Card says waiting on the brand; the engine refuses it.

rule: Blocked: more than 8 changes to one offer (assumed rule), for Instant Shock and the demo creators.
brand: Counter disabled at 8 of 8; accept or decline only.
creator: Counter disabled at 8 of 8; accept or decline only.

rule: Blocked: acting on a closed offer (accepted, declined, withdrawn, expired).
brand: Nothing changes.
creator: Nothing changes; told the offer is no longer open.

rule: A new deal starts with every milestone not funded.
brand: Awaiting funding, fund escrow.
creator: Awaiting funding; upload blocked with the reason.

rule: Funding by card puts milestones in escrow at once.
brand: In escrow; receipt paid (milestones + 5% fee).
creator: Funded, in progress; upload allowed.

rule: Funding by bank (ACH) is processing until it clears.
brand: Processing; clears moves it to escrow.
creator: Funding clears; upload blocked until it clears.

rule: Funding by wire waits until the wire arrives.
brand: Awaiting wire with a reference; received moves it to escrow.
creator: Funding clears; upload blocked until it arrives.

rule: The brand can fund the next milestone only, or everything remaining.
brand: Only the chosen milestones change.
creator: Only those deliverables become ready.

rule: Blocked: uploading proof for a deliverable whose money isn't in escrow (also on the seeded deals).
brand: Nothing new in approvals.
creator: Told why; no proof created.

rule: Uploading proof for a funded deliverable.
brand: The proof in Approvals with its amount.
creator: In review.

rule: Approving releases the milestone after a short undo window.
brand: Released; deliverable approved and paid.
creator: Released; 95% of the milestone in the wallet.

rule: Undo during the window cancels the release; approving again starts a new window.
brand: Back in review; a new approval releases only when its own window ends.
creator: Still in review; nothing paid.

rule: Requesting changes sends the deliverable back.
brand: Changes requested.
creator: Fix and re-upload; a new upload returns to review.

rule: When everything is released the deal completes.
brand: Completed; rate the creator; book again.
creator: Completed, paid in full; rate the brand.

rule: Blocked: releasing the same proof twice (double click, a second approve, two tabs at the same moment).
brand: One release.
creator: Paid once.

rule: Seeded deals: an approved proof releases its share of its own period's money in escrow (this month's payout on a monthly deal, never next month's or a renewal's); the last open deliverable releases what's left.
brand: Escrow goes down by exactly that amount.
creator: Wallet goes up by 95% of it; deliverable marked done.

rule: Milestones split the deal value to the cent, for any price.
brand: Milestones add up to the deal value.
creator: Same milestones and amounts.

rule: The brand fee is 5% of everything funded on a deal, rounded once.
brand: Receipts add up to funded + 5%, whether funded at once or in parts.
creator: Not shown.

rule: The creator fee is 5% of everything released on a deal, rounded once.
brand: Not shown.
creator: Receives released minus 5%, matching the offer card.

rule: Money is conserved on every deal.
brand: Funded = in escrow + released; same numbers on deal, payments and overview.
creator: Same escrow and released figures on the deal page and wallet.

rule: The wallet matches the releases.
brand: Not shown.
creator: One release row and one fee row per payout; balance moves by exactly the rows.

rule: Sending a renewal on a monthly deal.
brand: Renewal sent, waiting.
creator: Banner on the deal: accept or decline.

rule: Asking a brand to renew.
brand: Renewal request on the deal: accept or decline.
creator: Renewal requested, waiting.

rule: Accepting a renewal adds the new period as milestones to fund.
brand: Renewed; new milestones not funded.
creator: Renewed.

rule: Declining or withdrawing a renewal; each renewal is answered once, from any tab.
brand: Declined or gone; can send a new one.
creator: Declined or gone.

rule: Book again on a finished shared deal sends the same package as a pitch; not before the deal is complete, and one open pitch at a time.
brand: A pitch under Needs your response.
creator: Pitch sent.

rule: Rating the creator after completion.
brand: Your ratings.
creator: Line in the conversation with the score.

rule: Rating the brand after completion.
brand: Ratings creators gave you.
creator: You rated the brand.

rule: A message reaches the other side's thread.
brand: Message, unread until opened; seen once the creator reads it.
creator: Message, unread until opened; seen once the brand reads it.

rule: Offer, deal, funding, proof and payout events appear in the shared conversation.
brand: Event lines in the thread.
creator: Event lines in the thread.

rule: The creator's own packages are what brands can book.
brand: New package in Book a creator package; booking fills one deliverable per module.
creator: Offer with those deliverables.

rule: Everything survives a reload, seeded deals included.
brand: Same state after reload.
creator: Same state after reload.

rule: Two tabs (one creator, one brand) stay in step and never overwrite each other, even when both save at the same moment.
brand: Sees the creator's changes within seconds.
creator: Sees the brand's changes within seconds.

rule: Reset demo clears everything.
brand: Back to the seeded workspace.
creator: Back to the seeded dashboard.
